REQUEST TEST: Fecal Elastase

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal pancreatic enzyme levels and the persistence of systemic symptoms like night sweats and weight loss alongside your supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, have you experienced any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or changes in your voice? REQUEST TEST: LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase); REQUEST TEST: Tumor Markers (CEA, CA 19-9); REQUEST IMAGES: Chest CT.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin or Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma) presenting with B-symptoms and generalized lymphadenopathy.
